meta.name: Mario
meta.description: Antònia, 38, throws a surprise birthday party for her partner, Mario. Although they've been together for several years, she still hasn't met his friends, and for some reason she doesn't understand, Mario doesn't celebrate his birthdays. Antònia's family adores him. Mario is the kind of partner everyone dreams of having. He's one in a million. His friends idolize him. But after showering him with praise, they begin to notice that some of the stories Mario has told contradict each other and don't quite fit with the Mario everyone knows. Who is Mario, really?
